title: On the Frontline for Christ
story:
On the Frontline for Christ is more than a collection of songs. It is a musical journey through the struggles, discoveries, and victories of a life transformed by Jesus Christ. Each song has its own message, but together they tell a larger story—one that begins with God's grace, grows through faith, and ultimately leads to the enduring hope we have in our Savior.

Act I — A Life Transformed (Tracks 1–4)

The journey begins with You Changed Everything, a declaration of the difference Jesus makes in a person's life. What Grace Can Do celebrates the transforming power of God's grace, while The Final Word reminds us that our past failures and guilt do not have the final say over those who belong to Christ. Whose I Am completes this first chapter by reminding us that our identity is no longer defined by who we once were, but by whose we have become.

Act II — Learning to Walk by Faith (Tracks 5–6)

Transformation is only the beginning. Following Christ is a daily journey of learning to trust Him. I Don't Need to See the Road reminds us that faith does not require knowing every turn ahead. Don't Let Me Miss It encourages us to recognize God's goodness in the ordinary blessings of today, even as we trust Him with tomorrow.

Act III — Living on the Frontline (Tracks 7–9)

Faith was never intended to remain merely something we believe; it should change how we live. I Can't Surrender for You reminds us that each person must respond to Christ personally, while Something More challenges us to demonstrate His love through compassion, mercy, and service.

These songs lead us to Frontline, the album's defining declaration of faith and commitment. Its placement as Track 9 is intentional. Before we can fully understand what it means to stand for Christ, we must first understand His grace, discover our identity in Him, learn to trust Him, and allow His love to shape our lives. Standing on the frontline is not about fighting against people or relying on our own strength. It is about standing firm in God's truth, remaining faithful through adversity, and courageously living for Jesus Christ.

Act IV — Our Living Hope (Track 10)

The journey concludes with His Name Is Jesus. After everything we've experienced throughout the album, we arrive at the truth that gives meaning to every song before it: our hope is found in Jesus Christ.

The road ahead may still hold uncertainty, challenges, and difficult seasons. Faith does not promise a life without hardship. But through Christ's death and resurrection, we have the assurance that our struggles are not the end of the story.

On the Frontline for Christ begins with a life changed by grace and ends with a heart looking toward tomorrow with hope.

Because whatever lies ahead, our hope has a name—and His name is Jesus.
